t011.sum: Paradise is the eternal center of the universe of universes and the eternal Isle where the Father, the Son, and the Spirit dwell. At once a spiritual abode and a material sphere composed of absolutum, it is the source of all physical energy and gravity and the absolute of all patterns. It exists without time and has no location in space, and it is the destination that every God-knowing mortal is destined to reach at the end of the long ascent.
t011.s1.i1: Paradise is the eternal center of the universe of universes, where the Father, the Son, and the Spirit dwell with their co-ordinates, and it is the most gigantic organized body in the master universe.
t011.s1.i2: Paradise is both a spiritual abode and a material sphere; it has existed from eternity, and there are neither records nor traditions concerning its origin.
t011.s1.i3: The personal presence of the Father is at the center of upper Paradise, surrounded by the presence of the Eternal Son and enveloped by the glory of the Infinite Spirit.
t011.s1.i4: Whether one follows the lines of gravity, the lines of spirit gravity, the mind circuits, or the personality circuit, one eventually arrives at the central residence of the Father.
t011.s2.i1: Paradise is not spherical but a flattened ellipsoid, its north-south diameter one-sixth longer than its east-west diameter, providing the standard of absolute direction in the master universe.
t011.s2.i2: The Isle is divided into upper, peripheral, and nether Paradise; the Trinity seems to preside over the personal upper plane and the Unqualified Absolute over the impersonal nether plane.
t011.s2.i3: Paradise is composed of a homogeneous organization of space potency found nowhere else in the universe, which the Melchizedeks call absolutum.
t011.s2.i5: Roughly, space seems to originate just below nether Paradise, and time just above upper Paradise.
t011.s3.i1: Upper Paradise contains the Deity presence area, the Most Holy Sphere for worship and trinitization, and the Holy Area for residence.
t011.s3.i2: The seven concentric zones of the Holy Area are called "the Father's Paradise mansions," and the second zone is reserved for ascenders from the seven superuniverses.
t011.s3.i3: The residential provision for ascenders occupies less than one per cent of the assigned holy land, leaving ample room for beings yet to come.
t011.s3.i4: Peripheral Paradise is the landing place of space traversers and holds vast historic and prophetic exhibit areas for the local universes.
t011.s4.i1: All physical energy and cosmic-force circuits originate on nether Paradise, where no personalities dwell.
t011.s4.i2: The inner zone of the nether Paradise force center pulsates like a gigantic heart, sending currents to the outermost borders of physical space.
t011.s4.i3: The outer zone is believed to be the central focus of the space presence of the Unqualified Absolute, its emanations alternately outgoing and incoming in cycles of a little more than one billion years.
t011.s4.i4: All space alternately expands and contracts, one expansion-contraction cycle lasting a little more than two billion years of Urantia time.
t011.s4.i5: Space does not touch Paradise; Paradise is the motionless nucleus of the quiescent zones between pervaded and unpervaded space.
t011.s5.h: The Absolute of Gravity and Patterns
t011.s5.i2: Absolute gravity is Paradise gravity, while local or linear gravity pertains to the electrical stage of materialized energy.
t011.s5.i3: Paradise is the absolute source and the eternal focal point of all energy-matter in the universe of universes.
t011.s5.i4: The Paradise-Havona system is the eternal nucleus of the master universe, around which the seven superuniverses and outer space all revolve in established orbits.
t011.s5.i5: Paradise is neither creator nor Deity; it is the absolute of patterns, and Havona is the actual unfolding of its potentials.
t011.s5.i6: When the Father expressed his spiritual self in the Eternal Son, he simultaneously revealed the infinite potential of his nonpersonal self as Paradise.
t011.s6.i1: Paradise is to all spirit personalities the realm of primal origin and the goal of final destiny.
t011.s6.i2: Paradise is the geographic center of infinity, yet it is not part of any universal creation, Havona included, but an eternal and exclusive existence.
t011.s6.i4: The pilgrim who falls into the last sleep of time on the first circuit of Havona awakens on Paradise, and only then becomes a true child of Paradise.
t011.s6.i5: Discernible order and harmony prevail on Paradise, and conduct directors instruct new arrivals so that they may live there without confusion.
t011.s6.i6: God's dwelling place is the pattern for all universe headquarters worlds, and the central universe of his abode is the pattern for the ideals and destiny of all universes.
t012.sum: Havona is the eternal central universe of one billion perfect worlds surrounding the Isle of Paradise. Not a product of evolution but a universe created perfect from the beginning, it is the pattern for all universes, and the worlds of its seven circuits are the final training ground through which ascending pilgrims from the universes of time pass before entering Paradise. In its perfection, without government and without sin, Havona gives satisfaction to the Father and the creators and endless wonder to the ascenders.
t012.s1.h: The Eternal and Perfect Central Universe
t012.s1.i1: Havona is the perfect and divine universe at the center of all creation, around which swirl the vast creations of time and space.
t012.s1.i3: The Creator Sons aspire to duplicate in time and reproduce in space the divine perfection of this pattern universe.
t012.s1.i4: Havona is neither exactly finite nor absolute; it serves as a buffer between absolute Paradise and the finite creations.
t012.s1.i5: Havona is eternal, yet not static in the sense of being without growth; in this age it undergoes certain progressive changes in co-ordination with the evolving superuniverses.
t012.s2.i1: The billion worlds of Havona are arranged in seven concentric circuits surrounding the three circuits of the Paradise satellites.
t012.s2.i2: Each circuit is pervaded by a Circuit Spirit, a specialized expression of the Infinite Spirit, who co-ordinates the celestial affairs of that circuit.
t012.s2.i3: Outside lie the enormous dark gravity bodies, which neither reflect nor absorb light and revolve in opposite directions, concealing and stabilizing Havona.
t012.s2.i4: A Paradise-Havona day is nearly one thousand Urantia years and serves as the standard time of the seven superuniverses.
t012.s2.i5: Havona matter is organized in a threefold energy system, fundamentally different from the dual energy system of the superuniverses.
t012.s3.i2: Each Havona sphere is directed by an Eternal of Days of Trinity origin, and is developed according to his own plans with such originality that no two are alike.
t012.s3.i3: In Havona no creature, native or pilgrim, has ever sinned, and no ascending soul has ever entered before its time.
t012.s3.i4: Decay and death are not part of the Havona life cycle; lower living things are transmuted in form but never disintegrate.
t012.s3.i5: The Havona natives are offspring of the Paradise Trinity without creature parents, and by their very nature they live the will of God.
t012.s4.h: The Final Training Ground of Ascenders
t012.s4.i1: Pilgrims of time arrive on the receiving worlds of the seventh circuit and progress inward planet by planet and circuit by circuit until at last they reach Paradise.
t012.s4.i2: The pilgrim arrives in Havona possessing only one perfection, the perfection of purpose, tested and proved.
t012.s4.i4: Moving inward through the circuits, the pilgrim successively attains the identity of a Master Spirit, the Supreme Being, the Infinite Spirit, the Eternal Son, and the Universal Father.
t012.s4.i5: The term "circles of progress" for the human mind is derived from this circuit arrangement of the central universe.
t012.s5.i1: Life in the central universe is so rich and full that it transcends human concepts of what created beings can experience.
t012.s5.i3: Each of the billion worlds is a veritable university of surprises, and with every circuit crossed the pilgrim meets undreamed-of changes.
t012.s5.i4: Adventure and curiosity, often suppressed on earth, are divine endowments given to be fully satisfied in the long ages to come.
t012.s6.i1: The Father derives supreme parental satisfaction from the perfection of Havona and delights in the adoration of perfect creatures.
t012.s6.i2: Havona is the training ground where the Creator Sons prepare for universe creation, and every Creator Son seeks to bring his own universe to this level of perfection.
t012.s6.i3: Havona is a revelation of the perfect spirit nature of the Supreme Being and a foreshadowing of his future unification.
t012.s6.i5: In future ages too, Havona appears to hold unlimited potential as a training universe for absonite beings.
t013.sum: The master universe is the whole of creation, made up of six concentric elliptical space levels centered on Paradise: Havona, the seven superuniverses, and the four outer space levels. The part now organized and inhabited, Havona and the seven superuniverses, is called the grand universe. Vast future creations are even now taking form in outer space, and the ascenders of the perfected grand universe appear destined to serve there in time to come.
t013.s1.i1: The central divine universe together with the seven superuniverses around it is called the grand universe, the presently organized and inhabited creation.
t013.s1.i2: The master universe includes, in addition to the grand universe, the universes of outer space that are still uninhabited and in process of organization.
t013.s1.i3: Urantia belongs to the local universe of Nebadon, Nebadon to the seventh superuniverse of Orvonton, and the seven superuniverses revolve around the central universe of Havona.
t013.s1.i4: The grand universe has an evolutionary potential of about seven trillion inhabited planets, but its ragged edges are still unfinished.
t013.s2.i1: The master universe is neither an infinite plane nor an endless circle; it functions as one co-ordinated space unit with definite dimensions and limits.
t013.s2.i2: Outward from Paradise lie Havona, the seven superuniverses, and four outer space levels, arranged as concentric ellipses.
t013.s2.i4: Between the space levels there are zones of relative quiet, and successive levels revolve in alternately opposite directions, equalizing gravity tensions.
t013.s2.i6: The four outer space levels are destined to eventuate-evolve the ultimacy of creation.
t013.s3.i1: The first outer space level is a vast zone of energy activity beginning about one-half million light-years beyond the periphery of the grand universe and extending more than twenty-five million light-years.
t013.s3.i2: The space beyond the seven superuniverses is regarded as largely the domain of the Unqualified Absolute, and its energies are transmuted by the Paradise force organizers.
t013.s3.i3: The energy and matter of outer space already amount to many times the total mass of the seven superuniverses, yet no known material beings or angels live there.
t013.s3.i4: About ninety-five per cent of the absolute gravity of Paradise is now engaged in holding material systems beyond the borders of the presently organized universes.
t013.s3.i5: Spirit gravity functions almost entirely in the grand universe, so the outer universes appear still nonspiritual, while about fifteen per cent of mind gravity acts outside the grand universe.
t013.s4.i1: The physical creation of all pervaded space is now expanding uniformly outward, according to the space respiration cycle of some two billion years.
t013.s4.i2: The apparent recessional velocities of distant universes are not real but arise from several factors of error, such as angles of observation and time-space distortions.
t013.s4.i3: Space originates from Paradise but is not infinite, and time and space are inseparable only in the time-space creations of the seven superuniverses.
t013.s5.h: The Care That Embraces the Whole
t013.s5.i1: The needs of the whole master universe depend on the Absolutes for potential, on the Ultimate for direction, on the Supreme for evolutionary co-ordination, and on the Architects of the Master Universe for initial administration.
t013.s5.i2: The absonite Architects make the plans, the Supreme Creators bring them into being, and the Supreme Being completes their fullness.
t013.s5.i3: Mercy is God's attitude toward the individual and fairness his attitude toward the whole, and the will of God ultimately prevails throughout the universe of universes.
t013.s5.i4: Time and space are a cosmic mechanism that enables finite creatures to exist in the cosmos together with the Infinite.
t013.s5.i5: The new creations of outer space are believed to be the future field of activity of the assembling Corps of the Finality.
t013.s5.i6: In future ages the seven superuniverses seem destined to become the intermediate schools for beings from outer space, and Havona their finishing school.
t014.sum: The seven superuniverses are the creations evolving in time and space, formed by dividing the first space level beyond Havona into seven segments. Each superuniverse holds about one trillion inhabitable worlds, is ruled by three Ancients of Days from an architectural headquarters world, and is supervised from Paradise by one of the Seven Master Spirits. Orvonton, the seventh superuniverse, to which Urantia belongs, is known as a universe demonstration of love and mercy.
t014.s1.i1: As far as the Paradise Trinity is concerned, there are just seven inhabited universes outside Havona, and they hold jurisdiction over the first space level beyond Havona.
t014.s1.i3: The sevenfold plan of superuniverse organization was established early in the materialization of the universe creation, and the present administrative system has existed almost from eternity.
t014.s1.i4: The seven superuniverses revolve counterclockwise around Paradise and Havona along an enormous elliptical path.
t014.s1.i5: Urantia is not plunging blindly into unknown space but follows the orderly and predetermined path of the superuniverse space level.
t014.s2.i2: About one thousand inhabitable worlds form a system, one hundred systems a constellation, and one hundred constellations a local universe.
t014.s2.i3: One hundred local universes form a minor sector, one hundred minor sectors a major sector, and ten major sectors a superuniverse, holding about one trillion inhabitable planets.
t014.s2.i4: Some seven trillion inhabitable worlds are projected for the whole grand universe, but these figures are only approximations.
t014.s2.i5: Minor sectors are ruled by three Recents of Days, major sectors by three Perfections of Days, and superuniverses by three Ancients of Days.
t014.s3.i1: Nearly all the stars visible to the naked eye on Urantia belong to Orvonton, the seventh superuniverse, and the Milky Way is the central nucleus of Orvonton.
t014.s3.i2: The center of rotation of our minor sector lies in the Sagittarius star cloud, and all the sectors of Orvonton revolve around Uversa, its headquarters.
t014.s3.i3: Urantia is the 606th world in the system of Satania, belonging to Orvonton by way of Satania, Norlatiadek, Nebadon, Ensa, and Splandon.
t014.s4.i1: The Paradise force organizers are nebulae originators, mobilizing the forces of space to set in motion the vast mother wheels that give birth to suns and systems.
t014.s4.i2: Energy is distributed universally, not by nebulae, so that each local universe holds exactly one hundred-thousandth of the total energy of its superuniverse.
t014.s4.i3: All space bodies except the architectural spheres are of evolutionary origin, and our solar system consists of planets born in a process of gravity explosion.
t014.s4.i4: Light is real matter that has weight, as shown by the tails of comets pointing away from the sun.
t014.s5.i1: Superuniverse headquarters are specially constructed architectural worlds that give heatless light and lie near the astronomic center of each superuniverse.
t014.s5.i3: The executive of superuniverse government consists of the Ancients of Days, Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, and Universal Censors, together with the glorified ascendant mortals: Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, and Those without Name and Number.
t014.s5.i4: Each superuniverse is supervised by one of the Master Spirits of Paradise through the Reflective Spirits stationed at its capital.
t014.s5.i5: The Sons of the local universe can decree mortal survival, but executive verdicts concerning eternal life and death are rendered only by the Ancients of Days.
t014.s5.i6: The deliberative assembly of Uversa consists of representatives elected from among ascendant graduates qualified for Havona, and it has never disagreed with the executive.
t014.s6.h: Admission to the Confederation and Purpose
t014.s6.i1: A local universe may enter the superuniverse confederation only after achieving physical stability and spiritual loyalty to its Sovereign Son.
t014.s6.i2: Nebadon does not yet belong even to the settled physical order of the superuniverse, but the superuniverse government longs for its full admission and is helping it.
t014.s6.i3: The superuniverses are isolated from one another and learn of one another's affairs only through the Paradise clearinghouse, an isolation that will continue until the sovereignty of the Supreme Being is factualized.
t014.s6.i4: Each of the seven major purposes of superuniverse evolution is most fully expressed in one superuniverse.
t014.s6.i6: In Orvonton the purposes of the other six superuniverses are being linked together, and it is conjectured that God the Supreme may someday rule the perfected seven superuniverses from Uversa.
t015.sum: Nebadon is the local universe, organized and ruled by the Creator Son Michael and the Universe Mother Spirit, to which Urantia belongs. Destined to consist of one hundred constellations and ten thousand systems, it is a relatively young creation in Orvonton; from its capital, Salvington, Michael rules as representative of the Father and the Son, while Gabriel serves as chief executive. The local universe is evolutionary, and creatures attain perfection by ascending step by step from the bottom.
t015.s1.i1: A local universe is the handiwork of a Creator Son of the order of Michael; it consists of one hundred constellations, each containing one hundred systems.
t015.s1.i2: All the universes of time and space are evolutionary, and the plans of the Creator Sons always follow the path of the progressive development of creatures.
t015.s1.i3: A local universe is conceived by the Paradise Architects of the Master Universe, and the Creator Son begins its organization only after the power directors have mobilized the space energies.
t015.s1.i4: Nebadon extends as far as the space presence of the Mother Spirit of Salvington pervades; beyond that lies outside Nebadon.
t015.s2.i1: The first physical creation completed in Nebadon was the headquarters world, Salvington, followed by one hundred constellation headquarters and ten thousand system headquarters.
t015.s2.i2: Salvington is located at the exact energy-mass center of the local universe.
t015.s2.i3: At the last registry Nebadon had 3,840,101 inhabited planets, and the organization of planetary abodes is still in progress.
t015.s2.i4: Nebadon lies toward the edge of Orvonton, and Satania in turn lies on the outskirts of Nebadon.
t015.s2.i5: Nebadon is the eighty-fourth universe in the minor sector of Ensa, and Salvington is its capital.
t015.s3.i1: Michael of Nebadon is the 611,121st personalization of an original concept arising from the Father and the Eternal Son; he is not the Eternal Son of Paradise himself.
t015.s3.i3: Having completed his seven creature bestowals, Michael rules Nebadon as a sovereign of understanding mercy.
t015.s3.i4: His power is limited only by the Paradise gravity circuits and by the Ancients of Days, who reserve the final verdict concerning the extinction of personality.
t015.s3.i5: In local universe administration the Father functions only through the Creator Son, yet he is intimately present in mortals as the indwelling Adjuster.
t015.s4.h: The Joint Rule of the Son and the Spirit
t015.s4.i1: The Universe Mother Spirit creates and rules the universe together with Michael, and the Son grants the Spirit co-ordinate status and equal authority in all matters.
t015.s4.i2: When Michael returned from his bestowal on Urantia, the Universe Spirit for the first time publicly acknowledged her subordination to the Son.
t015.s4.i3: The Son then proclaimed in the "proclamation of equality" that the Spirit is equal to him in all attributes of personality, a lofty ideal for family and marriage.
t015.s4.i5: In facing rebellion only the Son functions as savior, yet no Son could succeed without the unceasing co-operation of the Divine Minister.
t015.s5.i1: Gabriel, the Bright and Morning Star, born of the first joint creation of the Son and the Spirit, is the chief executive of Nebadon.
t015.s5.i2: Immanuel of Salvington, the Trinity ambassador, is the only personality in Nebadon who does not acknowledge subordination to Michael, and he counsels only when asked.
t015.s5.i3: The systems attend chiefly to biologic problems, the constellations to social unity and stability, and the universe rulers to the spiritual status of the realms.
t015.s5.i4: Michael is concerned only with creation, sustenance, and ministry; creators never sit in judgment on their own creatures.
t015.s6.h: The Ascent and Purpose of Creatures
t015.s6.i2: The lower a creature is on the scale of life, the harder it is to recognize the Father in the Creator Son, but holding fast to the truth of the Father's presence in his Sons is the surest safeguard.
t015.s6.i3: Animal evolutionary origin is no stigma; those who climb the ladder of life from the bottom gain greater honor and fuller experience.
t015.s6.i4: The local universe is the starting point of true evolution, where imperfect personalities cocreate their own futures, and in which even the creators evolve.
t015.s6.i5: In the mind of God there is an eternal plan of infinite opportunity and endless life embracing every creature.
t016.sum: A local universe is divided into one hundred constellations, and each constellation into one hundred local systems. The constellation, ruled by the Most Highs of the Vorondadek order, is a legislative unit that socializes ascending mortals at headquarters such as Edentia; the local system, ruled by a System Sovereign of the Lanonandek order, is an executive unit that receives newly surviving mortals on Jerusem and the mansion worlds. Urantia belongs to the system of Satania in the constellation of Norlatiadek and has received special care since the Lucifer rebellion.
t016.s1.i1: Urantia is the 606th inhabited world of the system of Satania in Norlatiadek, one of the one hundred constellations of Nebadon.
t016.s1.i2: A system consists of about one thousand inhabitable worlds, and a constellation of one hundred systems.
t016.s1.i3: The constellations function as legislative units and the local systems as executive units, while the government of Salvington is the supreme judicial and co-ordinating authority.
t016.s1.i4: The constellation rulers link the local systems with the universe administration of Salvington and, through reflectivity, with the Ancients of Days on Uversa.
t016.s2.h: Constellation Government and the Most Highs
t016.s2.i1: A constellation is ruled by three Most Highs of the Vorondadek order, the presiding one being called the Constellation Father.
t016.s2.i3: The constellation legislature consists of three groups: a lower house of ascenders, a third house of seraphim and others, and an upper house of the divine Sons.
t016.s2.i4: The Most Highs are concerned with the welfare of nations and races rather than individuals, ruling in the kingdoms of men rather than in the individual heart.
t016.s2.i5: A Vorondadek observer is stationed on worlds isolated by rebellion, and it is he who actually "rules in the kingdoms of men."
t016.s2.i6: The Faithful of Days on Edentia stands beside the Constellation Fathers as the representative of the Trinity, but he never gives counsel unless asked.
t016.s3.i1: Edentia, the constellation headquarters, is about one hundred times as large as Urantia, and seventy major spheres and seven hundred satellites revolve around it.
t016.s3.i2: The constellation capital abounds in living adornment and is called "the gardens of God"; half the area of Edentia is given over to the gardens of the Most Highs.
t016.s3.i4: Passing through the seventy worlds, ascending mortals live with the univitatia and learn group ethics and the true socialization of morontia personality.
t016.s3.i6: The constellation sojourn is the midpoint on the way from animal-like being to ascendant spirit, the most uniform and stable period of the morontia career.
t016.s4.i1: The chief executive of a local system is the System Sovereign, a primary Lanonandek Son; the present sovereign of Satania is Lanaforge, Lucifer's successor.
t016.s4.i2: There have been three instances of disloyalty among System Sovereigns in the history of Nebadon, the Lucifer rebellion in Satania being the last and most extensive.
t016.s4.i3: Jerusem is surrounded by seven transition culture worlds and their satellites, and the seven mansion worlds are satellites of the first transition world.
t016.s4.i5: On Jerusem there is no separate day and night and no seasons, and the light is filtered evenly from the whole sky rather than from one source.
t016.s5.h: Ascension Training at the System Capital
t016.s5.i1: The mansion worlds are where mortals who did not fuse with their Adjusters in the life in the flesh are given the opportunity to resume their interrupted spiritual attainment.
t016.s5.i2: The Material Sons and Daughters, permanent citizens of Jerusem, become the immediate sponsors and teachers of ascending mortals.
t016.s5.i3: Ascenders lacking parental experience must make up this essential experience in the homes of the Material Sons on Jerusem or in the probationary nurseries.
t016.s5.i4: In Jerusem elections the value of a vote varies with the degree of morontia wisdom, and one may depart for the constellation only after attaining mota personality.
t016.s5.i5: The assemblies held on the world of the finaliters assure the mansion world sojourners that they too can complete the long journey.
t016.s6.i1: Since the Lucifer rebellion the Most Highs of Edentia have taken over certain phases of planetary authority on the rebellious worlds and still exercise it.
t016.s6.i2: Lucifer and most of the personalities who followed him are confined on the prison worlds around the Father's world of Jerusem, a solemn warning to all Nebadon.
t016.s6.i3: After the triumph of Christ Michael, Satan was unanimously rejected by the System Sovereigns at an Edentia conclave.
t016.s6.i5: The twenty-four counselors on Jerusem are persons of Urantia origin who represent Michael in the Satania roll calls and in the ascension plans of the isolated worlds.
t017.sum: Energy is the basis of all existence, an eternal but not infinite reality that goes out from Paradise and returns to Paradise. From space potency through primordial force and emergent energy to universe power and matter, it is transmuted by the force organizers and power directors, and light, heat, electricity, and matter are one in origin and destiny. Yet the universe is not mechanical; it stands within an order in which mind dominates matter and spirit rules mind.
t017.s1.i1: Energy is the basis of all existence, and pure energy is controlled by the Universal Father; the flow of energy going out from Paradise has never ceased.
t017.s1.i3: Viewed as nonspiritual phenomena, God is energy, and all physical energy proceeds from him.
t017.s1.i4: The creation of energy and the bestowal of life are the prerogatives of the Father and his creator personalities; however advanced, a scientist can never create an atom or add life to matter.
t017.s1.i6: Force-energy is imperishable and indestructible; it may be endlessly transmuted but never annihilated.
t017.s2.i1: Space potency (absoluta) is the free space presence of the Unqualified Absolute, responsive only to the personal grasp of the Universal Father.
t017.s2.i2: The Paradise force organizers transform space potency into primordial force (segregata) and further transmute it into puissant energy and gravity energy (ultimata).
t017.s2.i3: When energy reaches the stage of response to Paradise gravity, the power directors take over and handle universe power (gravita).
t017.s2.i4: Havona energy is not dual but triune (triata), and Paradise energy, monota, is distinguished from Paradise spirit only by name.
t017.s2.i5: Cosmic force, emergent energy, and universe power are distinguished by how they respond to Paradise gravity and linear gravity.
t017.s3.i2: The prime unit of material existence is the ultimaton, and exactly one hundred ultimatons make up one electron.
t017.s3.i3: The local universe has a decimal structure, so that atoms exist in only one hundred forms, with from one to one hundred orbital electrons.
t017.s3.i4: The atomic nucleus is held together by the mesotron, 180 times as heavy as the electron, which shuttles charges between protons and neutrons.
t017.s3.i5: Space is not empty; even the emptiest space known in Nebadon holds about one hundred ultimatons in each cubic inch.
t017.s3.i6: The recurrence of the properties of the elements in sevens is a birthmark of their sevenfold spiritual origin left on the material world.
t017.s4.h: The Circuit and Balance of Energy
t017.s4.i1: Though undergoing the transmutations of time, matter always swings on the circuit of eternity, ever responsive to the source from which it went out.
t017.s4.i2: Blazing suns turn matter into energy, while cold space and dark worlds slow energy back down into matter.
t017.s4.i3: The integrity of matter is assured by the fact that energy is absorbed or emitted only in quantum units.
t017.s4.i4: There is no ether; light and energy are streams of particles traveling in straight lines, appearing wavelike only because of the resistance of space.
t017.s4.i6: The living power directors and force organizers intelligently direct the endless metamorphoses of universe making, unmaking, and remaking.
t017.s5.i1: The universe is neither mechanical nor magical; it is a creation of mind and a mechanism of law.
t017.s5.i2: The universe of universes is planned, made, and managed by mind, yet its mechanism is so perfect that the methods of science cannot discern the trace of infinite mind.
t017.s5.i3: The nonspiritual energies are reunited in living systems of mind such as preadjutant spirit mind, adjutant spirit mind, morontia mind, and cosmic mind.
t017.s5.i6: Mind dominates matter and responds to the overcontrol of spirit, and only mind that freely follows the leading of spirit can survive beyond mortal existence.
t017.s5.i7: On Paradise physical, mindal, and spiritual energies are co-ordinate, in Havona they are co-ordinated, and on absolute levels spirit is definitely dominant.
t018.sum: Gravity is the all-powerful pull by which the physical presence of Paradise grips the worlds of all space. There are four absolute circuits in the universe: the personality gravity of the Father, the spirit gravity of the Son, the mind gravity of the Conjoint Actor, and the cosmic gravity of the Isle of Paradise, and they operate independent of time and space. Matter is held by Paradise gravity and linear gravity, but the more spiritual a human mind becomes, the less it responds to material gravity and the more it is drawn by spirit gravity toward Paradise.
t018.s1.i2: The center of absolute material gravity is the Isle of Paradise, complemented and equilibrated by the dark gravity bodies encircling Havona and by the space reservoirs above and below.
t018.s1.i3: The Universal Controller is potentially present in the gravity circuits of the Isle of Paradise, and that presence reaches every part of the universe to the same degree, according to mass.
t018.s1.i4: Since the lines of gravity from the ends of creation converge on the Father's abode, universal chaos would instantly result were he to move from that place.
t018.s1.i5: Each new universe requires a new adjustment of gravity, but the controlling power of Paradise is ample even for an infinite universe.
t018.s2.i1: There are four absolute circuits in the universe: the personality gravity of the Father, the spirit gravity of the Son, the mind gravity of the Conjoint Actor, and the cosmic gravity of the Isle of Paradise, and the Father acts through them all.
t018.s2.i3: All gravity is circuited in the Isle of Paradise, all mind in the Conjoint Actor, all spirit in the Eternal Son, and all personality in the personal presence of the Father.
t018.s2.i4: As the Father draws all personality and the Son all spiritual reality, so the Conjoint Actor exercises a drawing power over all mind.
t018.s2.i5: The operation of personality gravity is always a volitional act of the Universal Father, and the reality responding to its circuit cannot be measured.
t018.s3.i1: Absolute gravity is Paradise gravity, while local or linear gravity pertains to the electrical stage of energy and matter.
t018.s3.i2: Energy responds to Paradise gravity in three stages: pregravity (force), gravity (energy), and postgravity (universe power).
t018.s3.i3: Linear gravity becomes fully operative when the atomic organization of matter appears, while uncombined ultimatons respond only to the circular Paradise gravity.
t018.s3.i5: Linear gravity is the short-range cohesive force of the grand universe, and the phrase "inversely as the square of the distance" is only a rough approximation because of the influence of space.
t018.s3.i6: The theoretical absolute zero is never actually reached because of the presence and action of gravity.
t018.s4.i2: The Infinite Spirit possesses the power of antigravity, not observed in either the Father or the Son, and can transmit it to higher personalities.
t018.s4.i3: The arrangement of space levels revolving in alternately opposite directions keeps gravity pressures from building up to destructive points.
t018.s4.i4: The dark gravity bodies of Havona, with their inner and outer belts revolving in opposite directions, perfectly stabilize the central universe.
t018.s4.i5: The presently organized universes use only about five per cent of the absolute gravity of Paradise; the rest is engaged in holding the material systems of outer space.
t018.s5.i1: Spirit gravity is free from time lag, undiminished by space, and not retarded by material mass.
t018.s5.i2: Spiritual realities respond to spirit gravity according to their qualitative value, just as matter responds to physical gravity according to its quantity.
t018.s5.i4: Physical-gravity action is the quantitative measure of nonspirit energy, and spiritual-gravity action is the qualitative measure of the living energy of divinity.
t018.s5.i5: Spirituality in time and space is measured inversely to response to linear gravity.
t019.sum: Cosmic mind is the sevenfold diversified mind of time and space, ministered by each of the Seven Master Spirits to one of the seven superuniverses. It is the manifestation on finite levels of the absolute mind of the Infinite Spirit, reaching mortals in the local universe through the Mother Spirit and the adjutant mind-spirits, and it endows every will creature with three reality responses: causation, duty, and worship. Here lies the foundation of science, philosophy, and religion, and of strong character.
t019.s1.i1: Cosmic mind is the sevenfold diversified mind of time and space, each of the Seven Master Spirits ministering one phase of it to one superuniverse.
t019.s1.i2: The Master Spirits are the sevenfold source of cosmic mind and the intellectual potential of the grand universe, and cosmic mind is a subabsolute manifestation of the mind of the Third Source and Center.
t019.s1.i3: The mind bestowal upon the seven superuniverses proceeds from the Seven Master Spirits, and Nebadon is pervaded by the Nebadon modification of the Orvonton type of cosmic mind.
t019.s1.i5: Cosmic mind functions differently in each of the seven superuniverses, but it is co-ordinated in the Supreme Being by an unknown technique of association.
t019.s1.i6: On Paradise mind is absolute, in Havona absonite, and in Orvonton finite.
t019.s2.h: Through the Infinite Spirit and the Local Universe
t019.s2.i1: The mind presence of God is best discerned in the finite creation in the universal functioning of the cosmic mind of the Paradise Master Spirits.
t019.s2.i2: Yet the mind of the human order is the bestowal of the daughters of the Conjoint Actor, the Divine Ministers of the local universes.
t019.s2.i3: Urantians live under the influence of the Creative Spirit of Nebadon rather than the direct influence of a Master Spirit, yet the Master Spirits dominate the basic reactions of all creature mind.
t019.s2.i4: Human mind is an individualized circuit and impersonal part of the cosmic mind bestowed by the Creative Daughter upon the local universe.
t019.s2.i5: Cosmic mind extends from the primitive ministry of the adjutant spirits to the mind of the highest executives of the universe, unified under the supervision of the Seven Master Spirits.
t019.s3.i1: In every personality association of cosmic mind there is a "reality response" that saves will creatures from becoming helpless victims of the a priori assumptions of science, philosophy, and religion.
t019.s3.i2: Cosmic mind responds unfailingly on three levels of reality: causation (mathematical discrimination), duty (judicial discrimination), and worship (spiritual discrimination).
t019.s3.i4: When these three intuitions are unified in personality, they produce strong character, combining factual science, moral philosophy, and genuine religious experience.
t019.s3.i6: Yet too few on Urantia delight in cultivating such courageous and independent cosmic thinking.
t019.s4.i2: As nebulae originate in the cosmic energies of space, so intellectual selves originate in the cosmic mind.
t019.s4.i3: Only a personality knows what it is doing before it does it, possessing insight prior to experience.
t019.s4.i4: Virtue is righteousness in conformity with the cosmos, and virtue is known not by naming it but by living it.
t019.s4.i5: Morality cannot be advanced by law or force; it must spread by the contagion of contact with the morally fragrant.
t019.s5.i1: The conquest of the first cosmic circle ends the exclusive influence of the adjutant mind-spirits, and mind draws ever closer to the cosmic mind and the superadjutant endowments of the Creative Spirit.
t019.s5.i2: In the morontia stage the ascending mortal receives the Nebadon modification of the cosmic mind bestowed by the Master Spirit of Orvonton.
t019.s5.i3: Leaving the local universe and reaching spiritual levels, the ascender is attuned to the direct ministry of the Orvonton cosmic mind.
t019.s5.i4: Each time an evolving mind is attuned to the circuits of cosmic mind, the actuality of the Supreme becomes one step more real in the universe.
t020.sum: The Seven Master Spirits are the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit, each expressing one of the seven possible associations of the three Deities: Father, Son, and Spirit. From the periphery of Paradise each supervises one of the seven superuniverses, and they are the sevenfold source of cosmic mind and the ancestors of the power directors. The creatures of each superuniverse bear forever the distinctive character of its Master Spirit, and Master Spirit Number Seven, who supervises Orvonton, represents the Supreme Being.
t020.s1.i1: The Seven Master Spirits are the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit, and because there are only seven possible associations inherent in the three Deities, the universe is administered in seven great divisions.
t020.s1.i2: Each derives its character from one of seven likenesses: the Father, the Son, the Spirit, the Father and Son, the Father and Spirit, the Son and Spirit, and the Father, Son, and Spirit.
t020.s1.i4: Personalized by the first Deity-creative act of the Infinite Spirit, they are the distributors of the Infinite Spirit to the universes.
t020.s1.i5: In spiritual character and nature the Seven Spirits are as one, but in all other aspects of identity they are distinctly different.
t020.s2.h: The Voice of the Infinite Spirit
t020.s2.i2: The superuniverse presence of the Infinite Spirit on any world is conditioned by the distinctive nature of the Master Spirit supervising that segment.
t020.s2.i3: The attributes of omnipotence, omniscience, and omnipresence appear only when they act together; individually each is limited to the superuniverse under his supervision.
t020.s2.i4: When the Seven Master Spirits gather around the Conjoint Actor, they collectively represent the functional power, wisdom, and authority of the Trinity in the evolutionary universes.
t020.s2.i5: They are the third level of God the Sevenfold; ascenders, passing through the Ancients of Days, discover the personality of a Master Spirit before going on to the Father.
t020.s3.h: The Distinctive Character of the Seven
t020.s3.i1: Master Spirit Number One directly expresses the Father, is closely associated with the chief of the Adjusters, and in the council always speaks for the Father.
t020.s3.i2: Number Two portrays the Eternal Son, Number Three the Infinite Spirit, and Number Four the combined nature of the Father and the Son.
t020.s3.i3: Number Five portrays the Father and the Spirit and is the adviser of the power directors and physical controllers, while Number Six portrays the Son and the Spirit.
t020.s3.i4: Master Spirit Number Seven, presiding over Orvonton, portrays the Father, Son, and Spirit equally and has a personal and organic relationship with the spirit person of the Supreme Being.
t020.s4.i1: Each Master Spirit has headquarters on the periphery of Paradise opposite the superuniverse he supervises, and the radial boundary lines of that superuniverse converge there.
t020.s4.i2: The Master Spirits contact the superuniverse governments through the Seven Supreme Executives and maintain constant communication with the Reflective Spirits at each superuniverse capital.
t020.s4.i4: They are the sevenfold source of cosmic mind and the ancestors of the universe power directors, and they also assist materially the Creator Sons who organize the local universes.
t020.s4.i5: The morontia substance and morontia mind combining matter and spirit appear to be related to unrevealed activities of the Master Spirits.
t020.s4.i6: Yet they have nothing to do with the bestowal and ministry of the Adjusters or with the function of the Unqualified Absolute.
t020.s4.i7: In the present age the mind potential of the Supreme is entrusted to the Seven Master Spirits, and the Seventh Master Spirit in particular knows the Supreme and is in personal contact with him.
t020.s5.i1: Each world enjoys the combined wisdom of all seven Master Spirits, but receives its personal touch and coloring from only one.
t020.s5.i2: A Master Spirit does not enter the material mind of mortals directly; his influence comes through the ministry of the local universe Creative Spirit, who closely resembles him.
t020.s5.i4: So even the Corps of the Finality, when portraying a complete relationship to the evolutionary creation, assembles a group of seven finaliters, one from each superuniverse.
t020.s5.i5: On the seventh circuit of Havona the ascender must grasp the identity of the Master Spirit of his superuniverse before advancing to the sixth circuit.
t020.s5.i6: There are seven great avenues to the Universal Father, and each ascent is made through the divinity of one of the Seven Master Spirits.
